1.consolidated_definition: Podadora, cortadora. Máquina equipada con una guillotina que recorta materiales de distinta clase. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Se vende un trimmer electrico casi nuevo por $30 (Clasificados de Puerto Rico, consultado 05-05-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Strimmer, trimmer. Machine equipped with a guillotine that cuts materials of various kinds. Anglicism, commonly used. A nearly new electric strimmer is being sold for $30 (Puerto Rico Classifieds, consulted 05-05-08)
